name: Connect Interiors
old_description: Join us on Tuesday, August 11, from 1:00–4:00 PM for an afternoon of connection, inspiration, and celebration as we open the doors to our new office and showroom.
about:
Based in Fargo, North Dakota, Connect Interiors operates as an office furniture dealer serving clients across North Dakota and Minnesota. The company maintains a showroom and warehouse facility in Fargo with a staff of approximately 10 employees.

Connect Interiors provides turnkey workplace solutions through a single point of contact, covering the full lifecycle from exploration and strategy through planning, design, implementation, and ongoing management. Services include workplace discovery, budgeting, 3D space planning using CET Designer, product specification, financing and leasing options, warehouse receiving, delivery, installation, move management, reconfiguration, and onsite maintenance. The firm integrates furniture, audiovisual, and architectural systems for corporate, healthcare, education, government, and hospitality environments.

The company serves corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, government agencies, and hospitality venues. Its approach emphasizes maximizing existing assets as well as planning new spaces, with a portfolio that includes Steelcase products and a curated ancillary collection of lounge seating, tables, lighting, and accessories from global designers.

Connect Interiors positions its value on a structured four-phase methodology—Explore & Strategy, Plan & Design, Provide & Implementation, and Manage & Support—aimed at reducing real estate utilization costs, furniture acquisition expenses, and maintenance overhead while addressing social and environmental factors.
